```{r}
#| include: false
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

df <- read_csv(here("data/processed/submissions_cleaned.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))

# Entries have no name field of their own, so derive one from the repository
# URL: github.com/owner/repo -> repo, owner.github.io/pkg -> pkg.
derive_name <- function(url) {
  if (is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) return(NA_character_)
  u <- sub("/+$", "", sub("^https?://", "", url))
  parts <- strsplit(u, "/")[[1]]
  host <- parts[1]
  if (grepl("github\\.io$", host) && length(parts) >= 2) return(parts[2])
  if (identical(host, "github.com") && length(parts) >= 3) return(parts[3])
  if (length(parts) >= 2) return(parts[length(parts)])
  sub("\\..*$", "", host)
}

split_tags <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(character(0))
  out <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  out[nzchar(out)]
}

badge <- function(label, class = "") {
  if (is.na(label) || !nzchar(label)) return("")
  sprintf('<span class="badge-meta %s">%s</span>', class, esc(label))
}

all_keywords <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(df$`Code keywords`, split_tags))))

build_card <- function(i) {
  r    <- df[i, ]
  name <- derive_name(r$`Software website`)
  ck   <- split_tags(r$`Code keywords`)
  tk   <- split_tags(r$`Topic keywords`)

  title_html <- if (!is.na(name) && !is.na(r$`Software website`)) {
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
            esc(r$`Software website`), esc(name))
  } else {
    esc(name %||% r$`Code type`)
  }

  haystack <- tolower(paste(
    name, r$`Code maintainer`, r$Organisation, r$Description,
    paste(ck, collapse = " "), paste(tk, collapse = " "),
    r$Language, r$License, r$`Code type`
  ))

  tags_html <- if (length(tk)) {
    paste0('<ul class="entry-tags">',
           paste0(sprintf('<li>%s</li>', esc(tk)), collapse = ""),
           '</ul>')
  } else ""

  sprintf(
    '<article class="entry" data-search="%s" data-keywords="%s">
       <header class="entry-head">
         <h3 class="entry-name">%s</h3>
         <div class="entry-badges">%s%s%s</div>
       </header>
       <p class="entry-by">%s <span class="sep">/</span> %s</p>
       <p class="entry-desc">%s</p>
       %s
       <p class="entry-links"><a href="mailto:%s">Contact maintainer</a></p>
     </article>',
    esc(haystack),
    esc(tolower(paste(ck, collapse = "|"))),
    title_html,
    badge(r$Language, "is-lang"),
    badge(r$License, "is-license"),
    badge(r$`Code type`),
    esc(r$`Code maintainer`),
    esc(r$Organisation),
    esc(r$Description),
    tags_html,
    esc(r$Email)
  )
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a)) b else a

cards_html <- paste(vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), build_card, character(1)), collapse = "\n")

chips_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<button type="button" class="chip" data-key="%s" aria-pressed="false">%s</button>',
          esc(tolower(all_keywords)), esc(all_keywords)),
  collapse = ""
)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf('
<div class="db-controls">
  <label class="visually-hidden" for="db-search">Search the database</label>
  <input id="db-search" class="db-search" type="search" autocomplete="off"
         placeholder="Search by package, author, keyword or description…">
  <p class="db-count-line"><strong id="db-count">%d</strong> of %d entries</p>
</div>

<div class="db-chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by code keyword">
  %s
  <button type="button" class="chip chip-clear" id="db-clear">Clear filters</button>
</div>

<div class="db-results">
%s
</div>

<p class="db-empty" id="db-empty" hidden>No entries match that search. Try a broader term or clear the filters.</p>
', nrow(df), nrow(df), chips_html, cards_html))
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const input  = document.getElementById('db-search');
  const chips  = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.chip[data-key]'));
  const clear  = document.getElementById('db-clear');
  const cards  = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.entry'));
  const count  = document.getElementById('db-count');
  const empty  = document.getElementById('db-empty');
  const active = new Set();

  function apply() {
    const term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let shown = 0;
    cards.forEach(card => {
      const hay  = card.dataset.search || '';
      const keys = (card.dataset.keywords || '').split('|').filter(Boolean);
      const okText = !term || hay.includes(term);
      // OR within the facet: any selected keyword is enough to match.
      const okChip = active.size === 0 || keys.some(k => active.has(k));
      const show = okText && okChip;
      card.hidden = !show;
      if (show) shown++;
    });
    count.textContent = shown;
    empty.hidden = shown !== 0;
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', apply);

  chips.forEach(chip => chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const key = chip.dataset.key;
    const on  = active.has(key);
    if (on) { active.delete(key); } else { active.add(key); }
    chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!on));
    apply();
  }));

  clear.addEventListener('click', () => {
    active.clear();
    chips.forEach(c => c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false'));
    input.value = '';
    apply();
  });

  // Allow the landing page to deep-link a search or a keyword.
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const q = params.get('q');
  if (q) input.value = q;
  const k = (params.get('k') || '').toLowerCase();
  if (k) {
    const chip = chips.find(c => c.dataset.key === k);
    if (chip) { active.add(k); chip.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); }
  }
  apply();
})();
</script>
```
